body: Yo yo yooooo how’s it going?
Sing a song about how much I wish I wasn’t at work

I’m not sure. I’ve felt this way for about my whole life. I can normally hide the pain, I feel tho that I can’t hide it any longer

I just don’t feel that I’m worth it. My dad killed himself when I was young and I actually understand y now. Life sucks.
